# infoblox_tacacsplus_authservice (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Infoblox TacacsplusAuthservice from the NIOS backend.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve a specific TACACS+ Authservice by filters
data "infoblox_tacacsplus_authservice" "get_tacacsplus_authservice_using_filters" {
  filters = {
    name = "tacacsplus_authservice1"
  }
}

// Retrieve all TACACS+ Authservices
data "infoblox_tacacsplus_authservice" "get_all_tacacsplus_authservices" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes.
- `max_results` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `paging` (Number) Enable (1) or disable (0) paging for the data source query. Enabled by default. When disabled, only a single page of results is retrieved.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The reference to the object.
- `nios` (Attributes) NIOS backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios))

<a id="nestedatt--results--nios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.nios`

Read-Only:

- `acct_retries` (Number) The number of the accounting retries before giving up and moving on to the next server.
- `acct_timeout` (Number) The accounting retry period in milliseconds.
- `auth_retries` (Number) The number of the authentication/authorization retries before giving up and moving on to the next server.
- `auth_timeout` (Number) The authentication/authorization timeout period in milliseconds.
- `comment` (String) The TACACS+ authentication service descriptive comment.
- `disable` (Boolean) Determines whether the TACACS+ authentication service object is disabled.
- `name` (String) The TACACS+ authentication service name.
- `servers` (Attributes List) The list of the TACACS+ servers used for authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--results--nios--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.nios.servers`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The valid IP address or FQDN of the TACACS+ server.
- `auth_type` (String) The authentication protocol.
- `comment` (String) The TACACS+ descriptive comment.
- `disable` (Boolean) Determines whether the TACACS+ server is disabled.
- `port` (Number) The TACACS+ server port.
- `shared_secret` (String) The secret key with which to connect to the TACACS+ server.
- `use_accounting` (Boolean) Determines whether the TACACS+ accounting server is used.
- `use_mgmt_port` (Boolean) Determines whether the TACACS+ server is connected via the management interface.
